Treble Bleeds

Duncan Style Orange Drop Capacitor Treble Bleed 1nF + 150K

Apparitions take on the best of the best Treble Bleed! A hand-assembled treble bleed circuit using the popular 1nF capacitor + 150kΩ resistor parallel configuration, commonly known as the Duncan-style treble bleed. Designed to help retain high-frequency clarity as your guitar's volume control is rolled back, reducing the tendency for passive pickups to become darker or muddier at lower volume settings. Each circuit is hand assembled in the UK using branded, individually checked components and is electrically tested after assembly before being supplied.

Before you choose

A treble bleed connects across a volume control’s input and output. Its effect depends on your pickups, controls and cable; no one network suits every guitar.
